versions.content: If a DoIP message with payload Type 0x8001 is not received on a configured DoIPTcpConnection the message shall be discarded.
If a DoIP message with payload Type 0x8001 is not received on a configured DoIPTcpConnection the message shall be discarded.
When the module receives a DoIP message with payload Type 0x8001 on a connection different than a configured DoIPTcpConnection, the module shall discard the DoIP message.
